## Oldtimer Osint

**Category**: OSINT

**Description**: A nice starter mix of Cryptography and OSINT to get you warmed up. File SHA1: `78feb890a1caf98cdeb0b60e8b77d6697ddd1222`

The challenge file:
```shell
cat oldtimer-osint.txt  
56:47:46:75:5a:32:38:67:53:47:39:30:5a:57:77:67:52:57:4e:6f:62:79:41:67:52:6d:39:34:64:48:4a:76:64:43:42:4d:61:57:31:68:49:45:46:73:5a:6d:45:67:52:32:39:73:5a:69:41:67:53:57:35:6b:61:57:45:67:55:32:6c:6c:63:6e:4a:68:49:43:42:55:59:57:35:6e:62:79:42:49:62:33:52:6c:62:43:42:46:59:32:68:76:49:43:42:45:5a:57:78:30:59:53:42:42:62:47:5a:68:49:46:52:68:62:6d:64:76:49:45:56:6a:61:47:38:67:49:45:39:7a:59:32:46:79:49:45:5a:76:65:48:52:79:62:33:51:67:49:46:52:68:62:6d:64:76:49:45:68:76:64:47:56:73:49:45:56:6a:61:47:38:67:49:45:31:70:61:32:55:67:54:33:4e:6a:59:58:49:67:55:32:6c:6c:63:6e:4a:68:49:46:52:68:62:6d:64:76:49:43:42:53:62:32:31:6c:62:79:42:46:59:32:68:76:49:45:4e:6f:59:58:4a:73:61:57:55:67:52:57:4e:6f:62:79:42:4f:62:33:5a:6c:62:57:4a:6c:63:69:42:55:59:57:35:6e:62:79:41:67:51:6e:4a:68:64:6d:38:67:54:47:6c:74:59:53:42:50:63:32:4e:68:63:69:42:48 ... etc ...
```

In cybechef I do `find / replace : with space` > `from hex` > `from base64`:
```shell
Tango Hotel Echo  Foxtrot Lima Alfa Golf  India Sierra  Tango Hotel Echo  Delta Alfa Tango Echo  Oscar Foxtrot  Tango Hotel Echo  Mike Oscar Sierra Tango  Romeo Echo Charlie Echo November Tango  Bravo Lima Oscar Golf  Papa Oscar Sierra Tango  Foxtrot Romeo Oscar Mike  Tango Hotel Echo  Oscar Lima Delta Echo Sierra Tango  Sierra November Alfa Papa Sierra Hotel Oscar Tango  Oscar Foxtrot  Tango Hotel Echo  Mike India November Echo Charlie Romeo Alfa Foxtrot Tango  Whiskey Echo Bravo Sierra India Tango Echo  India November  Tango Hotel Echo  Foxtrot Oscar Romeo Mike Alfa Tango  Delta Delta Fraction bar Mike Mike Fraction bar Yankee Yankee Yankee Yankee  (Whiskey Romeo Alfa Papa Papa Echo Delta  Bravo Yankee  Tango Hotel Echo  Charlie Tango Foxtrot  Foxtrot Lima Alfa Golf  Foxtrot Oscar Romeo Mike Alfa Tango )
```

[cyberchef link](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=Find_/_Replace(%7B'option':'Regex','string':':'%7D,'',true,false,true,false)From_Hex('None')From_Base64('A-Za-z0-9%2B/%3D',true,false)&)

Translation:
```shell
THE FLAG IS THE DATE OF THE MOST RECENT BLOG POST FROM THE OLDEST SNAPSHOT OF THE MINECRAFT WEBSITE IN THE FORMAT DD/MM/YYYY (WRAPPED BY THE CTF FLAG FORMAT)
```

Oldest snapshot of the minecraft website: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090522105410/https://www.minecraft.net/](https://web.archive.org/web/20090522105410/https://www.minecraft.net/) 

Blog linked on the page: [https://web.archive.org/web/20090520172759/http://notch.tumblr.com/](https://web.archive.org/web/20090520172759/http://notch.tumblr.com/)

The most recent blog on the page is from May 20th 2009.

`TDHT{20/05/2009}`

## NBT Needle

**Category**: Misc

**Description**: The Named Binary Tag (NBT) is a tree data structure used by Minecraft in many save files to store arbitrary data. [Minecraft Fandom](https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/NBT_format). File SHA1: `fc167fb1101e2a68b3acb66fc146d662b4c47e01`

I get the challenge file:
```shell
sha1sum level.dat  
fc167fb1101e2a68b3acb66fc146d662b4c47e01  level.dat  

file level.dat  
level.dat: gzip compressed data, from Unix, original size modulo 2^32 3857
```

I put the file into [https://www.mcgic.com/nbt/](https://www.mcgic.com/nbt/) and it output all the data in plaintext. 

Or `gunzip` the file in cyberchef: [cyberchef
